name: Pure Mountain Sidr Honey
tagline: The flagship of the house — dark, complex, unmistakable.
description: Raw mountain sidr honey, gathered where the sidr tree blossoms for only a few short weeks a year. Dark, slow-pouring and rich, it is the honey we built this house on.
about: Sidr honey comes from bees that feed on the blossom of the sidr tree (Ziziphus spina-christi), a tree that has grown across Arabia and the Horn of Africa for thousands of years. The harvest window is famously short — a few weeks in the year — which is why genuine sidr honey has always been scarce, and why so much of what is sold under the name is not the real thing.

Ours is the same honey we have imported and supplied to the trade for years: raw and unheated, never blended, with the deep amber colour and long, complex finish that sidr is prized for. Every batch is traceable to its harvest.
The jar carries our name because we are the importer — there is no chain of middlemen between the harvest and your table.
enjoy: By the spoon, in the traditional way — many take it first thing in the morning
Stirred into warm (not boiling) water or milk
Drizzled over dates, yoghurt, porridge or good bread
Paired with black seed for the classic combination
storage: Keep at room temperature away from direct sunlight. Raw honey may crystallise naturally over time — stand the jar in warm water to loosen it. Do not refrigerate.
brands: Our own house selection, imported directly.

name: Black Seed Honey
tagline: Raw honey met with nigella sativa — the classic pairing.
description: Raw honey infused with black seed (nigella sativa), bringing together two of the most loved foods of the Islamic tradition in one dark, aromatic jar.
about: Black seed — habbat al-barakah, the blessed seed — has been part of the tradition for over a thousand years, and pairing it with raw honey is the oldest way of taking it. The seeds lend the honey a gently peppery, herbal edge that balances its sweetness.
We supply black seed honey prepared with genuine nigella sativa and raw honey, with nothing else added. It is one of the most asked-for jars in our range, in shops and homes alike.
enjoy: A spoonful on its own, traditionally in the morning
Stirred into warm water as a daily drink
Over yoghurt or porridge for a gently spiced sweetness
storage: Room temperature, away from sunlight. Stir before use if the seeds settle. Do not refrigerate.
brands: Selected import brands — ask us what is currently in stock.

name: Royal Honey Sachets
tagline: Honey with royal jelly, bee pollen and rainforest herbs, in single-serve sachets.
description: Single-serve sachets of honey blended with royal jelly, bee pollen and traditional rainforest herbs — a boxed format that travels well and sells fast.
about: Royal honey is a modern classic across the Gulf and Southeast Asia: honey enriched with royal jelly and bee pollen, presented in slim single-serve sachets. The boxed format makes it a popular gift and an easy sell at the counter.
We stock the VIP boxed sachets (12 per box) from established brands, halal-certified. Each sachet is taken straight — no preparation needed.
enjoy: One sachet, taken directly — no mixing required
Popular with tea or warm milk alongside
storage: Cool, dry place away from sunlight. Best enjoyed by the date printed on each sachet.
brands: Etumax VIP among others — ask us what is currently in stock.

name: Blessed Super Mix
tagline: Twenty-four traditional herbs in one honey-based blend, made in the UK.
description: A maximum-strength blend of twenty-four traditional ingredients — royal jelly, ginseng, propolis, ashwagandha, bee pollen, qust al-hindi, shilajit, sidr, black seed and more — bound in a dark honey base. Manufactured in the UK.
about: The Blessed Super Mix gathers the best-known ingredients of the traditional pantry into a single jar: royal jelly, ginseng, propolis, ashwagandha, bee pollen, qust al-hindi (Indian costus), shilajit, sidr, hemp and black seed among its twenty-four components.

It is made in the UK to a consistent recipe, and has built a loyal following among customers who would otherwise buy each ingredient separately. A dense, dark paste with a strong herbal character — a little goes a long way.
enjoy: A small spoonful, traditionally taken in the morning
Can be stirred into warm water or milk if preferred
storage: Room temperature, lid tightly closed. Stir if the blend separates. Keep out of reach of young children.
brands: Touch Holistics — Blessed Super Mix (Max Strength).

name: Ferula & Ginseng Honey Blend
tagline: A Turkish herbal honey preparation with ferula and ginseng.
description: A traditional Turkish preparation of honey and carob concentrate blended with ferula, ginseng and a selection of herbs — thick, warming and aromatic.
about: This is a classic of the Turkish herbalist's counter: honey and carob concentrate worked into a dense paste with ferula root, ginseng and complementary herbs. The result is dark, warming and distinctly aromatic.
We import it in the boxed 240g format from an established Turkish producer with decades of history. It is a steady seller in shops serving Turkish and Arab communities, and increasingly beyond them.
enjoy: A small spoonful taken on its own
Stirred into warm milk in the Turkish style
storage: Cool, dry place. Use the spoon provided or a clean, dry spoon each time.
brands: Merkez Efendi — Ferula Ginseng herbal mixed honey.

name: Ajwa Al-Madina Dates
tagline: The dates of Madinah — soft, dark and unhurried.
description: Genuine ajwa dates grown in Madinah — near-black, tender and gently sweet, presented in premium boxed formats from Saudi-certified producers.
about: Ajwa is the most treasured of all dates: grown in the orchards of Madinah, near-black in colour, with a tender bite and a restrained, almost cocoa-like sweetness. No date carries more meaning in the tradition, and none is more often imitated.

We import certified ajwa from Saudi producers — boxed and sealed at origin, with 'Saudi Made' certification on the pack — so what reaches you is exactly what left Madinah. Available in retail gift boxes and by the case for shops and mosques.
Ajwa boxes are one of our most popular gifts for Ramadan, Hajj and Umrah returns, and weddings.
enjoy: On their own, traditionally an odd number at a time
To open the fast in Ramadan
With Arabic coffee or a glass of milk
As a gift — the boxed formats are made for it
storage: Cool, dry place; refrigerate after opening for the longest life. Bring to room temperature before serving.
brands: Tamruk and Tahira premium boxed ajwa — both Saudi Made certified.
